title: WCP360 DSSE staging envelope candidate 0.1.0
$comment: DSSE 1.0.2 Ed25519 profile, exactly one signature. Runtime checks strict standard or URL-safe base64 (padded or unpadded), 64-byte signature, decoded payload up to 16 KiB and envelope up to 32 KiB, rejecting duplicate JSON keys. Unrecognized envelope/signature fields are ignored and never trusted.
